ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white pigmentation patches concentrated at distal tips and lateral margins; dense white mottling/spots in lower central lobe regions; primary low-intensity black field occupies mid-lobe and peduncle junction areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped median notch with an interior pixel angle of approximately 108 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth of approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; amplitudes vary from 3 to 15 pixels; most pronounced serrations and jagged peaks observed on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave sweep originating from the median notch, transitioning to a steep upward curve toward the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-12 pixel diameter) distributed across the dark ventral surfaces, primarily in the lower central regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct set of approximately five parallel, diagonal white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the left lobe, oriented at roughly 45 degrees to the vertical axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of high-contrast, textured calcified organisms (barnacles) localized at the right distal tip; secondary smaller cluster on the left distal tip; visible irregular indentation on the leading edge of the left lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'spray-like' pigmentation transition where white streaks and fine dots radiate from the base toward the center of the dark fluke lobes.
